To: Miranda Sissons • [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Lorri Anne Meils <[contact omitted]>
Subject: RE: USAID International Digital Democracy Initiative

Hi Miranda,
We just finished a call with another big tech company on the International Digital Democracy Initiative and
it was very fruitful. I wanted to follow up with you on this because I think it's important that you and
Facebook have a seat at the table. Please feel free to invite any colleagues you think should also be in
the meeting (I have separately reached out to Zvika Krieger and Ben Olsen from your Responsible
Innovation team).
All the best,
Betsy
From: Popken, Betsy (Colleen)
Sent: Sunday, August 15, 2021 10:50 AM
To: 'Miranda Sissons' < [contact omitted]>
Cc: 'Lorri Anne Meils' <[contact omitted]>
Subject: USAID International Digital Democracy Initiative
Hi Miranda,
I hope this email finds you well; it was good to see you at the Women's Tech & Human Rights happy hour last week. l'd
like to introduce you to Lorri Meils, Authoritarianism Advisor at USAID, who is coordinating an International Digital
Democracy Initiative across U.S. agencies in preparation for the Democracy Summit with heads of state in December.
Lorri and her colleagues are seeking input from expert practitioners—like you—on a vision for international coordination
of regulatory frameworks and digital infrastructure investments that align with democratic and human rights values, on
Al but also across the full digital ecosystem.
Their budget meeting is August 30, so Lorri and her colleagues would welcome a call with you before then. I will also
plan to join the call if I am able. Please let us know if you have any questions.
All the best,
Betsy
Betsy Popken
